change_summary: Added @triton.autotune with 6 configs using XBLOCK=16/32 (replacing wasteful XBLOCK=128 that masked 93% of X-dimension threads) and YBLOCK=32/64/128/256 (replacing YBLOCK=8), with a lambda grid in kernel_function that reads meta['XBLOCK'] and meta['YBLOCK'] instead of hardcoded values.
